annotations.title: Net salary in the Netherlands vs another country

description: Compares take-home pay in the Netherlands (2026, optionally with holiday allowance and the 30% ruling) with a salary in India, the United States, the United Kingdom, Germany, France, Greece, Spain, Romania, Bulgaria or China, converted to euros. Income tax and employee social contributions per country in a simplified model; pensions and local taxes are left out, as described in each country note.

country.description: Country to compare with: IN, US, GB, DE, FR, GR, ES, RO, BG or CN

fx_per_eur.description: Exchange rate: 1 euro = this many units of the other currency. Default: an indicative rate; ignored for euro countries.

home_gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in that country, in its own currency

nl_gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary offered in the Netherlands, in euros, without holiday allowance

nl_holiday_allowance.description: The Dutch offer pays 8% holiday allowance on top. Default true.

nl_thirty_percent_ruling.description: The 30% ruling applies in the Netherlands. Default false.

name: salary_country_comparison
title: Net salary in the Netherlands vs another country
